name: Shohei Ohtani
bio: The only player in MLB history to be both a legitimate MVP-caliber hitter and ace-caliber pitcher. A generational talent reshaping what baseball can be.

name: Mookie Betts
bio: Five-tool player and perennial Gold Glover. Betts brings elite defense, consistent offense, and championship pedigree wherever he plays.

name: Freddie Freeman
bio: One of the most consistent first basemen of his generation. Freeman's 2024 World Series walk-off grand slam is already the stuff of legend.

name: Aaron Judge
bio: The reigning AL MVP and one of the most feared hitters in baseball history. Judge's 62-homer 2022 season broke the AL record set by Roger Maris.

name: Gerrit Cole
bio: One of the premier starting pitchers in the game. Cole pairs elite stuff with elite command, making him a consistent Cy Young contender.

name: Juan Soto
bio: Perhaps the best plate discipline in the majors. Soto's combination of power, on-base ability, and youth make him a cornerstone for any franchise.

name: Ronald Acuña Jr.
bio: The 2023 NL MVP who became the first player ever to hit 40 home runs and steal 70 bases in a single season. A player unlike any other.

name: Spencer Strider
bio: One of the most electric arms in the game. Strider dominated hitters with an elite fastball-slider combo before injury cut his 2024 season short.

name: Yordan Alvarez
bio: A left-handed masher with elite bat speed and the ability to hit the ball harder than almost anyone else in baseball. A nightmare at-bat for any pitcher.

name: Francisco Lindor
bio: Mr. Smile. Lindor brings Gold Glove defense, All-Star offense, and unmatched energy to the Mets' clubhouse, making him the face of the franchise.
